words.def: A plan that shows when things will happen.
words.ex: My schedule is very busy this week.
words.exfa: برنامهٔ زمانی من این هفته خیلی پر است.

words.def: Money you receive every month for your job.
words.ex: He gets his salary on the last day of the month.
words.exfa: او معاشش را در آخرین روز ماه میگیرد.

words.def: A person who works for a company.
words.ex: The company has fifty employees.
words.exfa: این شرکت پنجاه کارمند دارد.

words.def: A person who is in charge of a team or an office.
words.ex: The manager called a meeting for Monday.
words.exfa: مدیر برای روز دوشنبه یک جلسه دایر کرد.

words.def: An event where people discuss something together.
words.ex: We have a meeting at ten o'clock.
words.exfa: ما ساعت ده جلسه داریم.

words.def: The last time by which you must finish something.
words.ex: The deadline for the report is Friday.
words.exfa: آخرین مهلت تسلیم گزارش روز جمعه است.

words.def: A talk given by a teacher at a university.
words.ex: The lecture was about economics.
words.exfa: لکچر دربارهٔ اقتصاد بود.

words.def: A title that a university gives you after your studies.
words.ex: She has a degree in medicine.
words.exfa: او مدرک تحصیلی در رشتهٔ طب دارد.

words.def: Money given to a student to pay for their studies.
words.ex: He won a scholarship to study abroad.
words.exfa: او برای تحصیل در خارج بورسیه گرفت.

words.def: Careful study to find new information.
words.ex: Her research is about farming.
words.exfa: تحقیق او دربارهٔ زراعت است.

words.def: Programs that run on a computer.
words.ex: I installed new software on my laptop.
words.exfa: من نرم‌افزار جدید را روی لپتاپم نصب کردم.

words.def: A secret word that lets you enter an account.
words.ex: Do not share your password with anyone.
words.exfa: رمز عبور خود را با کسی شریک نکن.

words.def: To copy a file from the internet to your device.
words.ex: You can download the app for free.
words.exfa: شما میتوانید این اپ را رایگان دانلود کنید.

words.def: The bags and suitcases you take on a trip.
words.ex: My luggage is very heavy.
words.exfa: بار سفر من خیلی سنگین است.

words.def: An official document you need to travel to other countries.
words.ex: Don't forget your passport.
words.exfa: پاسپورتت را فراموش نکن.

words.def: An arrangement to keep a room or a seat for you.
words.ex: I made a reservation at the hotel.
words.exfa: من در هوتل رزرو کردم.

words.def: A paper from a doctor that tells you which medicine to buy.
words.ex: The doctor gave me a prescription.
words.exfa: داکتر برایم نسخه داد.

words.def: A sign that shows you may be ill.
words.ex: A fever is a symptom of the flu.
words.exfa: تب یک نشانهٔ بیماری انفلونزا است.

words.def: To become better or to make something better.
words.ex: I want to improve my English.
words.exfa: میخواهم انگلیسی خود را بهتر سازم.

words.def: To choose something after thinking.
words.ex: She decided to study law.
words.exfa: او تصمیم گرفت حقوق بخواند.

words.def: Free to use, or free to meet.
words.ex: Is the manager available today?
words.exfa: آیا مدیر امروز وقت دارد؟

words.def: To stop trying.
words.ex: Don't give up. You are almost there.
words.exfa: تسلیم نشو. تقریباً رسیده‌ای.

words.def: To try to find something.
words.ex: I am looking for my keys.
words.exfa: من دنبال کلیدهایم میگردم.

words.def: To stop a machine or a light from working.
words.ex: Please turn off the lights.
words.exfa: لطفاً چراغ‌ها را خاموش کن.

words.def: A phrase you use to add something you just remembered.
words.ex: By the way, the class starts at nine.
words.exfa: راستی، صنف ساعت نُه شروع میشود.
